And after these things Mahdi marched to the land of the Romans,
and encamped by the river Pyramus in the district of Arabissus.
And his son Harun subdued the fortress of Semaluos, and took captives and departed.
And in the year 1092
of the Greeks) {OCR?} the Arabs took captive from Ephesus about seven thousand,
and also of the Arabs four thousand died.
Now King Leo sent an army and carried away captive the orthodox Syrian {OCR?} people,
and settled them in Thrace.
And it is said
that this King Leo also was a hater of images and adhered to the orthodox like his father.
And in that same year Leo died,
and Constantine his son reigned twenty-two years.
Because he was young when he began to reign,
his mother Irene governed and was proclaimed with him.
In the year 1094
(1094) Mahdi sent his son Harun against the royal city.
And the Romans devised a stratagem,
and hemmed in the Arabs at the river Sangarius,
where on one side was the mountain,
and on the other side the water.
And when the Arabs were hard pressed,
they sought peace for three years.
And Irene, with a womanly mind, consented,
and the Arabs departed.
And after a year 'Ali built the city of Hadath.
After Mahdi {OCR?}, Musa his son, one year and a month and a half.
Before this one reigned,
that is to say, in the year 1095
(1095 {OCR?} of the Greeks, 784 of our Lord),
the flying locust came and destroyed the crops,
and laid its eggs.
And they came forth and crawled {OCR?} and climbed up the walls and partitions,
and entered by the windows and doors into the houses.
And the water-jars also were filled with them, and the beds and tables and basins.
And when they entered a house from the southern side,
they went out from the northern {OCR?} side.
And together with the grass and trees they ate also woollen vessels and the garments of men.
And when they had consumed the whole region of Edessa and Sarug,
they passed over to the west.
And for three years after this severe chastisement,
there was a famine in the land.
And in the year 1097
(1097) the Romans went out and laid waste Hadath, which had been newly built by the Arabs,
and they devastated it and overthrew its walls completely.
And in the same year Musa died in the month of Tammuz.
After Musa, Harun al-Rashid his brother, twenty-three years and two months.
This one sent 'Abd al-Malik,
